cashB_sequential_retry.note: Sequential retry — proves cashB ITSELF can create orders; previous 422 in pool was concurrent contention.

top_concerns: P0_RED: Cross-user idempotency leak — DB UNIQUE on orders(branch_id, idempotency_key) lacks user_id; findExistingOrderForIdempotencyRecovery returns another user's order if keys collide.

P1_AMBER: POS order creation NOT recorded in audit_logs AND no DB column attributes the cashier (orders.user_id = customer, creator_id NULL). NF525 6-year trail cannot answer "which cashier opened order X".
P2_AMBER: Login events not recorded in audit_logs (authentication trail gap).
P2_AMBER: Logout events not recorded in audit_logs (session lifecycle gap).

additional_notes.POS_422_empty_message: PosController::store catch (Exception) at line 73 returns `{"status":false,"message":""}` when exception->getMessage() is empty. P2 observability gap — error UX is opaque.
additional_notes.OrderService_recovery_signature: app/Services/OrderService.php:2707 findExistingOrderForIdempotencyRecovery($key, $branchId) — no user_id filter. CLAUDE.md §9 says scope SHOULD be (branch_id, user_id, hash(key)). DB UNIQUE index orders_branch_id_idempotency_key_unique mirrors the gap.
additional_notes.middleware_per_user_scoping_works: IdempotencyKeyMiddleware scoped key includes user_id (idempotency:v1:{branch}:{user}:hash). Per-user isolation enforced at HTTP layer correctly. The leak lives ONE layer down at the app-layer fallback.
additional_notes.login_logout_relogin_chain_OK: Sanctum token revoke + reissue works correctly. Stale token → 401, distinct concurrent users have independent token rows.
additional_notes.branch_scope_under_concurrency_OK: BranchScope held under 4-way concurrent /api/admin/pos-order — each cashier only saw their own branch orders; admin (branch_id=0) saw cross-branch as expected.
